title: Average of three
prompt: Return the average of a, b and c: add them together and divide by three. Watch out — the answer can have decimals.
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> float:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> float:
	return 0.0
hint: If you divide by 3 (an int) you lose the decimals. Divide by 3.0 instead.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> float:
	return (a + b + c) / 3.0
